subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Identified potential performance implications of removing page cache folio stealing, including temporary increased memory consumption and potential slowdowns for certain workloads. Requested additional context on why the change is necessary.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch series proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to steal page cache folios, which can lead to premature folio refcount drops and potential data corruption. The change involves dropping the ->try_steal function from page_cache_pipe_buf_ops and modifying fuse_try_move_folio() and virtio_console's pipe_to_sg() to copy instead of stealing when SPLICE_F_MOVE is set.
